newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian Reinsurance debuts at 7.50 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian Reinsurance debuts at 7.50 rgt.

text.p: Malaysian National Reinsurance Bhd debuted on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Wednesday at 7.50 ringgit, compared with a 4.30 ringgit offer price.
At 0150 GMT, the stock was trading at 8.00 ringgit after more than seven million shares changed hands.
The company, which listed on the Main Board, offered 19.1 million shares to the public.
Malaysian National Reinsurance's principle activity is the underwriting of all classes of general reinsurance business. It is 85 percent owned by state investment agency, Permodalan Nasional Bhd.
For the year ending March 31, 1997, the company has forecast a pre-tax profit of 77.92 million ringgit, against 75.53 million in the 1995/96 financial year.
In a report issued on Wednesday, Jupiter Securities said the company should continue to register an average growth of 17 percent in operating revenue for the next three years.
Jupiter Securities has recommended buying the stock up to 7.00 ringgit.
